audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Renekton levels 1-2 and 'Skill' for every stage from level 3 onward, while the 3017-game packet chart and the page's own whys give Mordekaiser rows 2-6 outright.
audit.why: Renekton is at 48.39% here. The whys already read as Mordekaiser wins: 'he out-sustains your burst pattern', 'beat your burst in a prolonged trade', 'the 1v1 unwinnable'. The mirror audit on the Mordekaiser side flipped rows 1-6 in both layers to Skill + Mordekaiser x5, so this side must state the same.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Renekton, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser in both layers, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.why: Spikes are already accurate and specific: level 2 combo window, level 6 Realm of Death, Rylai's, full AP late. Renekton's only real spike is level 2-3; Mordekaiser's R at 140s rank 1 defines every stage after.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: empowered Ruthless Predator (above 50 Fury) DESTROYS damage shields on the target — which is exactly what Indestructible is — and doubles the stun from 0.75s to 1.5s.
audit.why: Riot's Renekton W text: 'he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target... stunning them for 1.5 seconds'. Mordekaiser's W stores damage into a shield he may consume to heal. So the empowered W removes the stored shield outright; his counterplay is to cash it into the heal first. This is the mirror's point-4 finding restated from your side.
audit.corrected: Say it in the do's and in Key Ability Interactions: bank 50 Fury and land empowered W to destroy Indestructible before he converts it to a heal.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140s rank 1 is correctly named as the window; the mid text already gives the number.
